# mtncloud_project (Data Source)

Looks up one project by ID or by name, with the group and cloud it is in. A project is where instances, MTN Networks, MTN Routers and security groups live. To list them, use `mtncloud_projects`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By the name shown in the console; `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_project" "web" {
  name = "web-prod"
}

output "web_project" {
  value = {
    id    = data.mtncloud_project.web.id
    group = data.mtncloud_project.web.group
    cloud = data.mtncloud_project.web.cloud
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Project ID. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Project name as shown in the console, for example `web-prod`; the full platform name, with the tenant suffix, also works. Give this or `id`. Always set to the name without the suffix.

### Read-Only

- `cloud` (String) Cloud the project is in, for example `MTNNG_CLOUD_AZ_1`.
- `external_id` (String) Project ID in the cloud (the external ID).
- `full_name` (String) Full platform name, with the tenant suffix, for example `web-prod-Acme`.
- `group` (String) Group the project is in.
